title: Front Range Blizzard: Come to Bed With Me? 8 Hours of Howling Wind and Snow for Deep Sleep
description:
Come to bed with me? A March hike in the Colorado foothills, high ridges, pines and a snowy canyon under a blue sky, until a blizzard rolls in off the Front Range. The snow thickens, the sky goes white, and it all fades slowly to pure black by twenty minutes so nothing lights up your room. Then it's just you, Mateo and the storm for eight hours, warm inside while it blows.

Deep steady wind, long gusts that swell and sigh away, a soft low howl around the eaves, and fine snow ticking on the glass. No thunder, no music, no talking, nothing sudden. The storm never loops: every gust is generated fresh by Sandoval Studios. Photos shot in the Front Range foothills west of Denver.

REST. DIGEST. Goodnight.
